question: If in a certain code language, REWARI is coded as TGYCTK, then how is DELHI coded in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/3tuELsedTf7tmpX1myNfd4kOCqi8E_SmumrFAjlMpa9Q57qja9YILr3ppcjA3UGCK8u3I-jp5Ww1p_07Fk3HgOu18JL_2d4odA368OnvUMlfaaMMBmxnn8sknIwe3Tf4E849C-SZ=s0] 

The pattern followed is:

If in a certain code language, REWARI is coded as TGYCTK. Which are given below -

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/832b8eda05c40c5e2ea04ed4bdc83685e2afb5ce9bcfe407154395f77b4f70c3.png] 

Similarly, then DELHI coded in the same code language -

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/825fc8659467a6e16a258d0d85bbdbc7f246a28177daa63ec4d71e23efd4cf76.png] 

Hence, **"FGNJK"** is the correct answer.
